text:
Predicates:
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Stable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
Formed(x, y) ::: x is formed in y.
Include(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
Leads(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Formed(diamondMine, wwe) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable, formed in WWE.
Include(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ∧ Include(diamondMine, ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers, and Ivy Nile.
Feud(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
Leads(roderickStrong, stable) ::: Roderick Strong leads a professional wrestling stable.
